prompts.name: pinky-hands
prompts.prompt: Create a single educational illustration for a young children's typing game. Hand-drawn colored pencil and soft gouache, warm ivory paper background, thick friendly navy outlines, charming clean classroom picture-book style. Landscape composition, two human hands seen FROM ABOVE, backs of hands visible, wrists at bottom, fingertips pointing up, left hand on left and right hand on right, thumbs point inward. Exactly five anatomically clear digits per hand, relaxed and gently spread. Highlight ONLY BOTH PINKY fingers bright bubblegum PINK #ec4899 from knuckle to fingertip. All other digits neutral warm peach. Small pink sparkles by highlighted pinkies. Do not color palms. Fingers must be easy for a child to identify. No writing, no labels, no keyboard, no faces, no additional hands. Hands occupy central 80 percent with generous clear margins. This is final standalone image pinky-hands.

prompts.name: kitty-elbows
prompts.prompt: Final standalone educational landscape illustration for young children learning typing posture. Hand-drawn colored pencil and gouache on warm ivory paper, thick friendly navy outlines, cheerful picture-book classroom style. TWO very clear side-by-side scenes. LEFT and larger: cute orange tabby kitten sitting upright at a small desk, front paws gently poised over keyboard, elbows tucked close to sides, ready-to-pounce paws. A clear large green check above kitten. RIGHT and smaller: silly friendly yellow chicken at another keyboard with elbows / wings stuck far OUT sideways, a clear pink X above chicken. Show computer screens and small wooden desks. The lesson is kitty pounce elbows in, not chicken wings elbows out. Keep faces kind and funny. Simple clean composition with generous margin, few props. No text or letters anywhere, no captions. Real instructional differences in elbow position must be visible.

prompts.name: sit-tall
prompts.prompt: Final standalone educational landscape illustration for young children learning typing posture. Hand-drawn colored pencil and gouache on warm ivory paper, thick friendly navy outlines, cheerful children's picture-book classroom style. SIDE VIEW of a smiling young child with curly dark hair and teal shirt sitting TALL and upright at a wooden table using a desktop computer. Head centered above straight back, relaxed shoulders, elbows tucked close to torso and bent comfortably, forearms level with table, fingers on external keyboard, monitor at eye height, both feet supported flat on low footrest. Chair and full body clearly visible. Small friendly orange kitten sits beside the chair. A simple green upward arrow beside straight back suggests sitting tall. Minimal uncluttered setting, generous margins, no text, no letters, no captions.

prompts.name: home-row
prompts.prompt: Final standalone educational landscape illustration for young children learning typing. Hand-drawn colored pencil and gouache on warm ivory paper, thick friendly navy outlines, cheerful clean picture-book style. A playful keyboard's middle HOME ROW transformed into a neat row of EIGHT tiny welcoming houses, each house is a single keyboard key with a triangular roof and a little front door. Exactly eight houses from left to right in these colors: pink, yellow, orange, green, green, orange, yellow, pink. A LEFT hand and RIGHT hand shown just above them, relaxed hovering with four fingertips on each side returning to their matching colored key-houses, thumbs relaxed below. Exactly five digits per hand, hands seen from above. Cozy friendly visual metaphor: every finger has a home. Two tiny sky blue stepping-stone keys in central gap suggest G and H reaches. NO letters or words anywhere; accurate letter labels will be added in the app. Simple uncluttered educational composition, no clutter, no captions, plenty of margins.
